caption: The drawing depicts three human figures standing against a plain, off-white background. The figure on the left is wearing a black long-sleeve top, a cream-colored headscarf with a small floral pattern, and a long blue skirt with white geometric designs; this figure has one hand on their hip and the other resting on their skirt. The middle figure wears a red long-sleeve blouse with white circular designs, a blue checked skirt, a blue patterned headscarf that covers the hair, a brown crossbody strap, a beige bag, and wooden sandals, with one hand on their hip and the other holding a walking stick. The figure on the right is dressed in dark blue pants, a white and blue striped shirt, a red scarf or bandana, a wide-brimmed black hat, and carries a musket on their shoulder as well as a blue bag at their side. All three figures are facing forward and are illustrated in full length, while the drawing uses colored pencils or watercolor to depict the textures and patterns in their clothing.
title: American Dolls
